meta.name: hunt-idor
meta.description: Hunting skill for idor vulnerabilities. Built from 26 public bug bounty reports. Use when hunting idor on any target.

copy.tagline: 发现并利用 IDOR 漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在寻找 Web 应用中的 IDOR 漏洞
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are hunting for IDOR vulnerabilities in web applications

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会指导你系统性地测试 Web 应用中的 IDOR 漏洞，包括识别高风险资产、枚举对象引用、使用两个账户验证访问控制，并尝试绕过防御措施。
howto.when: 当你要求进行安全测试或漏洞挖掘，特别是针对 IDOR（不安全的直接对象引用）漏洞时触发。

say.text: 帮我测试这个 API 端点是否存在 IDOR 漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会指导你如何测试指定端点。

say.text: 如何枚举用户 ID 并测试跨用户访问？
say.note: Claude 会提供枚举和测试步骤。

say.text: GraphQL 端点如何测试 IDOR？
say.note: Claude 会给出 GraphQL 特定的测试方法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through systematically testing web applications for IDOR vulnerabilities, including identifying high-value assets, enumerating object references, using two accounts to verify access controls, and attempting bypass techniques.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for security testing or vulnerability hunting, specifically for IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) vulnerabilities.

say_en.text: Help me test this API endpoint for IDOR vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through testing the specified endpoint.

say_en.text: How to enumerate user IDs and test cross-user access?
say_en.note: Claude will provide enumeration and testing steps.

say_en.text: How to test IDOR on GraphQL endpoints?
say_en.note: Claude will give GraphQL-specific testing methods.
